{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_data = data[~qa_mask & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = filtered_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

# Print results
print(f'Conversion rates by segment: {conversion_rates.to_dict()}')
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}')"}
